pages.text: The $(l)Elf Archer$() is a precise ranged unit. She can only be equipped with classical bows and excels at delivering elemental ranged support from a distance.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 40$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 5$(li)$(6)Damage:$() 4.0 - 5.0 per hit$(br2)Has a $(b)50% chance$() to fire a special arrow based on the accessory held in her off hand.
Crafted with nature's essence and fine marksmanship.

pages.title: Accessories (1/2)
pages.text: $(li)$(c)Blaze Rod Earring:$() Fires piercing flame arrows.$(br2)$(li)$(8)Wither Rose Brooch:$() Fires piercing arrows that inflict Wither I for 10 seconds.

pages.title: Accessories (2/2)
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Ghast Tear Pendant:$() Fires piercing arrows with a 50% chance of a small explosion on impact.$(br2)$(li)$(5)Dragon Hairpin:$() Fires piercing arrows that create dragon's breath on the ground.
Used to make the tears explode.
